name: Feature request

---

**Problem**
What are you trying to do that arnon doesn't support today? Prefer a
concrete scenario over an abstract one.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like arnon to do. If it touches an existing opinionated
default (middleware order, validation, error format, ...), say
whether you're proposing a new default or a way to override the
existing one - see "Por que Arnon" in the README for the project's own
criteria on when an opinion should exist and how it should be
overridable.

**Alternatives considered**
Anything else you tried, including working around it outside arnon.

**RFC/standard, if any**
If this maps to an existing IETF RFC or other standard, link it - see
[AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md) and
[docs/architecture/rfc-compliance.md](../../docs/architecture/rfc-compliance.md)
for how the project prefers grounding decisions in a spec over
inventing a new convention.
